## Overview

Events flow left to right through four stages. This page exists to give the visual suite a terminal block.

## Running it

Start the pipeline locally:

```terminal
$ git clone https://example.com/fixture/pipeline.git
$ cd pipeline
$ docker compose up -d

Pipeline is running at http://localhost:8080
```

## What it shows

The terminal block keeps its own palette in both themes, which the dark baseline checks.
